# @aponiajs/core

> The module graph, visibility rules, and dependency injection container that an AponiaJS application is compiled and run on.

This package consumes frozen descriptors only. It never imports `reflect-metadata` or decorator logic, so a decorated module and a hand-written `defineModule` module compile through the same code. Most HTTP applications receive it transitively through `@aponiajs/platform-elysia`; install it with `bun add @aponiajs/core @aponiajs/common` when building a platform adapter or using the container alone.

## What this package exports

- [compileModuleGraph](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/core/src/graph/graph-compiler.ts): walks imports depth-first and validates the whole graph before any instance exists.
- [ModuleGraph](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/core/src/graph/module-graph.ts): resolves a token against a module's own providers first, then against imports that export it.
- [createContainer, AponiaContainer](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/core/src/container/container.ts): creates the container and caches one instance per provider per module.

## Public types

- [GraphInspection, ModuleInspection, ProviderLocation](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/core/src/graph/graph.types.ts): the frozen shapes returned for inspecting a compiled graph.

## Behavior a consumer can rely on

- Compilation is eager and fails before an instance exists: duplicate module identity, import cycles, duplicate tokens inside a module, exports of tokens the module cannot resolve, and unresolvable provider or controller dependencies.
- Modules are identified by `instanceId ?? id`, so two configured instances of one module class stay distinct.
- A provider left out of a module's `exports` is invisible to importers, and two imports exporting the same token raise `AMBIGUOUS_PROVIDER` instead of picking a winner.
- `AponiaContainer.get` enforces root-module visibility and detects provider dependency cycles while resolving.
